disclaimer: Illustrative story. People and data are fictional.

personas.name: Sara Ahmed
personas.goal: A beginner 3-day split she can log offline at a basement gym
personas.headline: How Sara logged her first consistent month
personas.summary: Sara trains in a basement gym with weak signal. Phone for the logger on the floor, iPad for My Plan on the bus, laptop for progress charts on Sundays.

day.title: Plan on the bus
day.text: On the bus Sara opens My Plan on her iPad and confirms today’s 3-day split before she even reaches the basement gym with the unreliable signal.

day.title: First warm-up set
day.text: Phone logger open on the first warm-up set — kilograms and reps save locally with no cloud spinner, which matters when the Wi-Fi dies mid-session.

day.title: Superset done
day.text: Still offline for the superset; the rest timer ticks on the phone while she watches the clock on the wall, not an app store login wall.

day.title: Sunday charts
day.text: Sunday evening she opens the laptop progress chart and smiles at three finished sessions — volume up gently, ego left outside.

day.title: Next week tweak
day.text: She nudges next week’s load on My Plan from the laptop, then closes the lid. The basement will still be offline. The log will still work.

video.transcript: Sara reviews My Plan on iPad, logs sets offline on iPhone, and checks progress on laptop. Fictional.

personas.quote: The basement has no signal. The log still works.

personas.name: Daniel Okonkwo
personas.headline: How Daniel mixes runs and lifts without losing the thread
personas.summary: Daniel coaches himself between client meetings. Phone at the track, iPad for mobility, laptop for long progress reviews.

day.title: Track intervals
day.text: At the track Daniel keeps the phone in hand for interval notes — pace, rest, how the left knee felt — one log instead of a separate running app he never opens.

day.title: Desk mobility
day.text: Between client calls he opens a short mobility block on the iPad at his desk, twelve minutes, then back to email without changing clothes.

day.title: Strength session
day.text: After work the phone logger takes squats and accessories; last week’s numbers are already there so he is not guessing under fluorescent lights.

day.title: Week review
day.text: Laptop charts at night show volume trending up gently — strength and runs in one place, no spreadsheet archaeology.

day.title: Coach tip
day.text: A rules-based Smart Coach tip appears on the laptop — not an LLM sermon, just a cue he accepts or dismisses with one tap.

before.label: Separate apps for run vs lift

video.transcript: Daniel logs runs and lifts on phone, mobility on iPad, reviews charts on laptop. Fictional.

personas.quote: One log for legs and long runs.

personas.name: Khalid Al-Rashid
personas.goal: Doctor-approved walking plus light weights, large text
personas.headline: How Khalid kept moving after clearance
personas.summary: Khalid’s doctor cleared light training. Large text on phone, iPad for calm plan view, laptop when his son visits to help.

day.title: Morning walk log
day.text: Before fajr traffic, Khalid logs a 25-minute walk on his iPhone with large text — slow is still training, and the doctor’s clearance lives in the note.

day.title: Light session plan
day.text: Afternoon iPad shows today’s light weights clearly enough that he does not need his son to interpret tiny labels at the gym.

day.title: Sets done
day.text: Phone logger for two machines only; he finishes, drinks water, and leaves without chasing a streak or a personal record.

day.title: Son checks in
day.text: When his son visits they open the laptop together and skim the week at a glance — walks logged, light days honest, nothing performative.

day.title: Tomorrow ready
day.text: Phone reminder set for tomorrow’s walk. He locks the screen feeling capable, not behind.

video.transcript: Khalid logs walks and light weights across phone and iPad, reviews with family on laptop. Fictional.
